title: Qcqs constant-coefficient invariance assembled by dimension shifting
statement: For algebraically closed fields k subset K, a qcqs morphism f:X -> Spec k, n with (n:k) nonzero and q a natural number, the canonical Etale.cohomologyMap along X_K -> X with coefficients X.constantZMod n is bijective. Its target is the cohomology of the inverse image of that constant sheaf, with the statement of the adopted source declaration unchanged.

source.place: Lemma 59.90.2(1), with its comparison assembled using the acyclic-resolution argument of Tags 095T and 03FD

proof.text: Prove comparison for underlying abelian sheaves of arbitrary Z/n-module sheaves simultaneously in every degree. The new scalar-extension sections input gives degree-zero comparison via the existing canonical degree-zero theorem.

For the successor degree, embed M into an injective J and form its cokernel Q. The new scalar-extension acyclicity input supplies the existing effacement ladder, giving right exact cohomology rows and surjective connecting maps on both schemes. The induction hypothesis makes the maps for J and Q bijective, and pullback naturality supplies the first commuting square. The right-exact five-lemma proves comparison for M in degree q+1. This is a real Lean induction, independent of whether n is prime.

The endomorphism n times identity of ULift(Z/n) is zero, and the additive constant-sheaf functor preserves this equality. Hence X.constantZMod n is killed by n and lifts to a module sheaf M by the existing module-lift theorem. Apply the induction to M, then transport its injectivity and surjectivity through the induced cohomology isomorphisms on X and X_K; naturality of cohomologyMap identifies the transported map with the exact map in the original statement.
